title: Remove core's outbound MCP client fallback; MCP servers are reached through the commercial plug
goal: Vision: V-9. Core half of the first pillar move (board 2488; decisions 2470, 2506). Commercial's ecosystem_hub.mcp.call / list_tools plug now spawns stdio servers with core's own builder and carries core's fallback tests (commercial T-CORESIZEVAULT-19, afca15dc). Delete crates/susi-tools/src/mcp_budget.rs's fallback (execute_mcp_rpc, the HTTP exchange, stdio spawn and JSON-RPC reader, the connect cooldown; about 350 runtime lines) so call_blocking_result and list_tools_blocking answer through the bus only and, with no host wired, return an error naming susi-plug-host --supervise. Move with it the conformance cases that reach external MCP servers through it end to end: tests/gmcp_requirements/vc_203_017.rs and vc_203_017_part2.rs (GmcpClient::execute_external_tool_result) must run against a plug host, in commercial or with an in-test host, not be deleted. Lower COMPLETE_SOCKET_CEILING to the new measure.

reuse.searched: Commercial susi-ecosystem-hub migrated::susi_vendor_mcp (the destination, already serving ecosystem_hub.mcp.call), core susi_config::mcp (stdio builder and header validation, which stay in core).

limitations: Without the Susi Commercial Apps plug host, core reaches no external MCP server (CEO decisions 2470, 2506). The connect-failure cooldown, header checks, cwd template and hidden console are now the plug host's (commercial afca15dc; Windows and Linux passes, board 2558). GMCP mastery evidence must be re-recorded after this commit (cargo local-release record-gmcp).
progress: Fallback deleted: mcp_budget.rs now authorizes and forwards on ecosystem_hub.mcp.call / list_tools with a bus_timeout_ms read bound, naming susi-plug-host --supervise when nothing serves them. VC-203-017 cases reach their in-test servers through tests/gmcp_requirements/mcp_plug_double.rs (core's McpHost). Ceiling 291,802 -> 291,422.
